value.description: The value of the radio button when selected.

title.description: The main title text displayed for the radio button option.

subtitle.description:
Optional subtitle/description text displayed below the title.
Provides additional context about the radio button option.

enabled.description:
Whether this specific radio button option is enabled (true) or disabled (false).
Defaults to true if not specified. Can be overridden by the group's enabled property.

title: Configuration for an individual radio button option within the group
name: SubtitledRadioButtonOption
